title: FIFTY-FIFTY Double Lock-On Mountain Bike Grips, Bicycle Handlebar Locking Grips, Non-Slip MTB Handle

reviews.title: Great Grips
reviews.body: These were wicked easy to put on my bike. They look and feel great. Went on my first bike ride this evening with them. Only took 10 minutes to put them on. Tools are not included. I could not be happier and would recommend them to anyone. They are a bit pricey but are a quality product and seems durable.  Will buy another two sets when I get to working on my other bikes.

reviews.title: Good bang for your buck
reviews.body: Nice grips overall, comfortable, easy to install and plenty of color options. The only thing I don’t like about them is they’re not the toughest grips. My bike tipped over in the garage and the end cap broke off. Every day riders having fun and doing light dirt trails your good to go, if your a more aggressive rider bombing hills at Whistler bike park forget about it.

reviews.title: Comfort
reviews.body: These fit great on my 25.4mm handlebars. I've got Origin8 riser bars, and although I've ridden risers, flat, bullhorn, track drops, and even Scott touring bars, I've always used grip tape, until recently.I switched to grips versus tape after switching to risers long term and the comfort and control has improved versus the hockey tape I normally use.Cool colors available too! The gum ones match my gumwall gravel tires nicely.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 21, 2026
reviews.author: Jon

features: Comfortable and Durable: This mountain bike grips is made of soft and durable rubber. It can absorb shocks and make your hands feel comfortable even with or without gloves on a long ride
Super Grip: The more textured non-slip surface pattern provides extra grip. The bike grips are also very slip resistant when riding in wet weather
Dual Lock-on Design: the dual lock-on clamp ensures that the mtb grips are more secure and do not slip during the most intense rides
Easy to Install - Installation is easy as long as you get your old bicycle grips off and securely locked into place
Very Light: Only 98g per pair, the MTB handlebar grips fit for diameter 22.2 mm bike handlebars
